_comment: Captured from a live Kimi Code session (TM-071) and sanitised. This is the shape Kimi sends on stdin to a PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook: base fields hook_event_name/session_id/session_title/client_type/cwd, then tool_name + tool_input for tool events (https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/customization/hooks.html). The TodoList tool schema carries title + status only — no item ids — so the adapter keys rows by a content hash of the title.
